description: This file defines the interface for a PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) processor in a 5G NR simulation or implementation, including related data structures, configuration parameters, and notifier interface.

classes.name: pdsch_processor_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifications upon completion of PDSCH processing.

classes.name: pdsch_processor
classes.description: Interface for processing PDSCH transmissions, including configuration and processing methods.

classes.name: pdsch_pdu_validator
classes.description: Interface for validating PDSCH processing configuration parameters.

methods.name: ~pdsch_processor
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the PDSCH processor interface.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Method to process a PDSCH transmission, writing to resource grid and notifying upon completion.

methods.name: ~pdsch_pdu_validator
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the PDSCH PDU validator interface.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates the PDSCH processing parameters, returning success or error message.
